shared_elements: human figures in profile with weapons
group of armed men in a row
elongated wheeled/vehicular or hull-like object with rows of internal strokes
justification: Both show profile human figures carrying weapons (bows/spears) in a row, with an elongated object bearing repeated internal strokes — a siege engine on wheels in A, ships with crew-strokes in B — but this is a generic warrior-with-weapon correspondence rather than a shared motif. A depicts a detailed architectural siege scene with towers, crenellated walls, gate and archers rendered with modelled anatomy and drapery, while B shows tiny stick-like silhouette figures and boats scattered freely on an open field with no architecture and no naturalistic detail.
